icerikStudyosu.aciklama: Write AI-assisted content in your brand voice, plan your social media calendar and get a ready-to-share pack. You publish the posts on the channels yourself.
icerikStudyosu.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's own content and content prepared for clients: brand voice, AI writer, calendar, client approval and ready-to-share pack.
icerikStudyosu.uyariAiKapali: No AI provider is configured: the AI writer and refinements are off. The planner, brand voice and templates keep working.
icerikStudyosu.uyariSahte: Test environment: AI responses are fake (fixed); no real model is called.
icerikStudyosu.yayinNotu: No direct publishing: posts are not sent to Instagram, LinkedIn, X or other channels by software. When it is time, copy the text from the "Ready to share" pack, post it on the channel and mark it as published. CSV export for Postiz/Buffer is available.

hesap.musteriIcin: You are preparing content for {{hesap}}: posts are saved to the client's account and the client only sees what you submit for approval.
hesap.modulKapali: The client's Content studio module is off; the approval screen still works.

linkedin_gonderi.aciklama: Professional yet human; a hook in the first two lines, a question at the end.

google_isletme.aciklama: A local, concrete update; one call to action, no hashtags.
